question: Under what condition can killing lead to an auspicious destination?
premises: Killing is mentioned as an action.
The welfare of many is presented as a condition.
An auspicious destination is stated as the result.
inference: If killing results in the welfare of many, it can lead to an auspicious destination.
uncertainties: The ethical scope and limits of this exception are not specified in this verse.
plain_english: If the killing of one brings welfare to many, it may lead to an auspicious destination.
